title: MOS sandbox sim file
description: Initial state and command effects of the mock spacecraft (public/sim/<mission>-sim.json).

defaultCadence.description: Virtual seconds between telemetry samples of every parameter (0 = no periodic samples).

latency.description: [min, max] virtual seconds a command takes to complete when the effect has no `delay`. Default [0.4, 1.2].

commandCounter.description: Qualified name of the pseudo-parameter that counts issued commands. Default /MOS/CommandCounter.

initial.description: Initial value per parameter (qualified name or generated class name). Enum parameters take the enum member value (member names and case-insensitive labels are accepted). Parameters not listed start at their type default: enum = first member, numbers = 0, bool = false, string = ''.

cadence.description: Per-parameter sampling period in virtual seconds (overrides defaultCadence; 0 = only event driven samples).

rates.description: Numeric parameters that change continuously: value = last set value + rate * seconds since it was set (e.g. an uptime counter with rate 1).

effects.description: What commands do. All effects matching an issued command are applied when the command completes successfully.

setValue.description: A literal value, or one of the dynamic forms.

fromArg.description: Wire name of a command argument; its value is copied.

expr.description: Python expression. Names: args (dict of wire args; each arg is also a plain variable), prev (previous value), t (virtual seconds), math, min, max, abs, round, int, float, str.

setMap.description: Parameter qualified name -> new value. Each change also produces an immediate telemetry sample.

command.description: Qualified command name (/FF/EPS/Set_slrPnl3_Thrld), generated class name (EPSSetSlrPnl3Thrld) or a glob (/FF/EPS/Set_*).

when.description: Only match when these wire arguments have these values (a list means any of; strings and numbers compare loosely).

delay.description: Virtual seconds from issue to completion (default: random within `latency`).

sample.description: Parameters that get an immediate telemetry sample on completion (without changing their value).

fail.description: Make the command fail (ack NOK) whenever this effect matches.
